directoryDescription: Find a published performance to check its schedule, review affected orders or manage a change.
directoryFailed: Could not load performances. Try again.
noMatchesHelp: Try another name or clear the search to return to the list.
noShowsHelp: A performance appears here after the organizer submits it for publication.
showUnavailable: This performance is unavailable in the operations directory.
syncing: Waiting for ticket sales and check-in to confirm the update. This page refreshes automatically.
noActions: There are no actions available for the current status.
impactFailed: Could not load affected orders. Try again.
impactHelp: These orders are checked when this performance is rescheduled or cancelled.
offerWindowHelp: Ticket types keep their current sales windows. The new window must cover those dates.
reasonRequired: Enter the reason for this change.
futureSaleEnd: The closing time must be in the future.
consequence_POSTPONE: Ticket sales and check-in will pause while this change is processed. Resume sales from this page after synchronization.
consequence_CANCEL: This stops ticket sales and admission for this performance. Affected orders enter the support workflow.
consequence_RESUME: Ticket sales can resume during the configured sale window after the services acknowledge this update.
consequence_COMPLETE: The performance will be marked as completed. Ticket sales and admission will close.
waitForImpact: Load the affected orders to make changes to this performance.
